headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4, section titles, and marketing hooks. Never use Inter.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, descriptions, and UI text.

mono.usage: Use for odds (superodds), probabilities, and data metrics.

layouts.public_site: Asymmetric grids. Hero section with dark overlay over stadium imagery. Staggered feature cards. Generous padding (p-12 to p-24).
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid system (MODE B: High Density). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy, data correlation. Sidebar fixed on desktop.
layouts.container: Max-w-7xl for public pages, full-width with sidebar for admin.

responsive.layout: Stack elements on mobile (grid-cols-1). Ensure complex tables or bento grids overflow horizontally or stack cleanly. Desktop uses sidebar.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling. H1 starts at text-4xl on mobile, up to text-6xl on desktop. Keep body text at text-base for mobile readability.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure all grid containers have min-w-0 and charts are responsive. Prevent x-axis scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: Min 44x44px for all mobile interactive elements (bottom nav icons, buttons).

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation (Início, Bilhetes, Ao vivo, Calendário, Perfil). Glassmorphism background: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px border-t border-white/10. Z-index 50.
navigation.desktop: Fixed left sidebar. Graphite background (bg-[#121212]). Active state uses neon green text and 2px left border.

cards.base: Flat solid background (bg-[#1A1A1A]), 1px border (border-white/5), no heavy shadows.
cards.premium: Add a subtle tracing beam or neon border glow for FULL plan cards or premium tips.
cards.bet_slip_card: Header with match info, body with odds/tips (JetBrains Mono). Include status badge on top right.

badges.green: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/20 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs
badges.red: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs
badges.void: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs
badges.pending: bg-zinc-500/10 text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-500/20 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-md hover:bg-[#E6FF4D] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md transition-colors

visual_enhancers.glows: Subtle green glows (box-shadow or radial-gradient backgrounds with opacity) behind key metrics or premium CTA buttons. Limit to max 1-2 per screen.
visual_enhancers.borders: Optical clarity. Always ground dark UI elements with 1px border-white/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain texture on the dark background to kill digital flatness, enhancing the premium feel.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion.loading: Skeleton loading (shimmer effect using dark gray gradients bg-white/5 to bg-white/10) for all data-fetching components.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards (subtle -translate-y-1). Toast notifications for actions (use Sonner).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #1A1A1A meets minimum 4.5:1. Black text on #CCFF00 ensures optimal readability.
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus states for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

logo_horizontal.description: VÉRTICE SPORTS horizontal logo in lime green and black

hero_background.description: Soccer field at night, to be used with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) for the public landing page hero.

analytics_abstract.description: Dark analytics charts, useful for feature sections or intelligence dashboard.

critical_rules: NO purple or violet gradients. Do not use centered layouts. Use left-aligned, asymmetric grids.
Use dark backgrounds (#0A0A0A) with very subtle neon green (#CCFF00) accents. Avoid making the UI too colorful.
Always use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for layouts. Use shadcn/ui for complex interactive logic.
Use .js files (not .tsx) for the components and pages.
Implement a Mobile-first bottom nav for small screens, and a fixed left sidebar for desktop.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-btn").
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays. Use bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl.
Fonts: Clash Display (Headings), Manrope (Body), JetBrains Mono (Data/Odds). DO NOT use Inter.
For bet slips (bilhetes), explicitly use the status colors defined (Green, Red, Void, Pending) as distinct badges.
Use Lucide-React for icons, or Phosphor Icons if a more technical look is desired.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, specific transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
